declarations.excerpt:

theorem quadraticChar_card_sqrts (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) (a : F) :
    #{x : F | x ^ 2 = a}.toFinset = quadraticChar F a + 1 := by
  -- we consider the cases `a = 0`, `a` is a nonzero square and `a` is a nonsquare in turn
  by_cases h₀ : a = 0
  · simp only [h₀, sq_eq_zero_iff, Set.ofPred_eq_eq_singleton, Set.toFinset_card,
    Set.card_singleton, Int.natCast_succ, Int.ofNat_zero, MulChar.map_zero]
  · set s := {x : F | x ^ 2 = a}.toFinset
    by_cases h : IsSquare a
    · rw [(quadraticChar_one_iff_isSquare h₀).mpr h]
      rcases h with ⟨b, h⟩
      rw [h, mul_self_eq_zero] at h₀
      have h₁ : s = [b, -b].toFinset := by
        ext1
        rw [← pow_two] at h
        simp_rw [s, Set.toFinset_ofPred, mem_filter_univ, h, List.toFinset_cons, List.toFinset_nil,
          insert_empty_eq, mem_insert, mem_singleton]
        exact sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg
      norm_cast
      rw [h₁, List.toFinset_cons, List.toFinset_cons, List.toFinset_nil]
      exact card_pair (Ne.symm (mt (Ring.eq_self_iff_eq_zero_of_char_ne_two hF).mp h₀))
    · rw [quadraticChar_neg_one_iff_not_isSquare.mpr h]
      simp only [neg_add_cancel, Int.natCast_eq_zero, card_eq_zero, eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
      simpa [s, isSquare_iff_exists_sq, eq_comm] using h

/-- The sum over the values of the quadratic character is zero when the characteristic is odd. -/
theorem quadraticChar_sum_zero (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) : ∑ a : F, quadraticChar F a = 0 :=
  sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one (quadraticChar_ne_one hF)

/-- The quadratic character is `1` or `-1` on nonzero arguments. -/
theorem quadraticChar_dichotomy {a : F} (ha : a ≠ 0) :

  sq_eq_one_iff.1 <| quadraticChar_sq_one ha

/-- The quadratic character is `1` or `-1` on nonzero arguments. -/

  ⟨fun h ↦ by rw [h]; lia, fun h₂ ↦ (or_iff_right h₂).mp (quadraticChar_dichotomy ha)⟩

/-- For `a : F`, `quadraticChar F a = -1 ↔ ¬ IsSquare a`. -/
theorem quadraticChar_neg_one_iff_not_isSquare {a : F} : quadraticChar F a = -1 ↔ ¬IsSquare a := by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · simp only [ha, MulChar.map_zero, zero_eq_neg, one_ne_zero, IsSquare.zero, not_true]
  · rw [quadraticChar_eq_neg_one_iff_not_one ha, quadraticChar_one_iff_isSquare ha]

\begin{lemma}[The two reduced group cardinalities]
\label{lem:v5-two-reductions}
Let $p>76176$ be prime and let $\pi\in\Z[i]$ have norm $p$, with
$\pi\equiv9\pmod{16}$ and $\pi\equiv1+3i\pmod7$.
The two reductions of $E/K$ at the places above $p$ have group
cardinalities $N(\pi-1)$ and $N(\pi+1)$, in some order.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
The congruences give $p\equiv1\pmod8$ and $p\equiv3\pmod7$.
Thus $p$ splits in $K$ and $(7/p)=-1$. The reductions of
$d=3-\sqrt2$ have product 7 and opposite square classes. The two
curves $y^2=x^3-d^2x$ are consequently opposite quadratic twists
of $y^2=x^3-x$ and have opposite traces.

The Frobenius calculation already given in
Section~\ref{subsec:o8-pattern-proof} applies: the order-four
automorphism is defined over $\F_p$, its rational centralizer is
$\Q(i)$, and integrality puts Frobenius in $\Z[i]$.
Write it as $a+bi$, so $a^2+b^2=p$ and the two cardinalities are
$p+1-2a$ and $p+1+2a$. Full rational two-torsion makes both
cardinalities divisible by four. Since $p\equiv1\pmod4$, this
forces $a$ odd and $b$ even. The real part of $\pi$ is odd and its
imaginary part is even. Unique factorization in $\Z[i]$ therefore
makes $a+bi$ one of $\pm\pi,\pm\overline\pi$; the associates
with factor $i$ have the wrong parity. Hence the unordered
cardinalities are exactly $N(\pi-1),N(\pi+1)$.
\end{proof}

declarations.name: lemma neighbor_errors
declarations.excerpt:
lemma neighbor_errors (p : ℕ) (a b : ℤ) (hp : (p:ℤ)=a^2+b^2) :
    (minus a b:ℤ)-(p:ℤ)=1-2*a ∧ (plus a b:ℤ)-(p:ℤ)=1+2*a := by
  simp only [minus,plus,norm_cast,hp]
  constructor <;> ring

end GaussianNeighborNorms318

declarations.name: theorem negative_root
declarations.excerpt:
theorem negative_root (rho : ℚ_[p]) (hr : rho^2=2) : (-rho)^2=2 := by
  simpa using hr

theorem conjugate_embedding (rho : ℚ_[p]) (hr : rho^2=2) (a b : ℚ) :
    embedding p (-rho) (negative_root p rho hr) (pair a b)=
      embedding p rho hr (pair a (-b)) := by
  simp [embedding_pair]

theorem norm_identity (rho : ℚ_[p]) (hr : rho^2=2) (a b : ℚ) :
    embedding p rho hr (pair a b)*embedding p (-rho) (negative_root p rho hr) (pair a b)=
      ((a^2-2*b^2:ℚ):ℚ_[p]) := by
  simp only [embedding_pair,Rat.cast_sub,Rat.cast_pow,Rat.cast_mul,Rat.cast_ofNat]
  linear_combination -(b:ℚ_[p])^2*hr

theorem norm_valuation (rho : ℚ_[p]) (hr : rho^2=2) (a b : ℚ) :
    place p rho hr (pair a b)+place p (-rho) (negative_root p rho hr) (pair a b)=
      rationalPlace p (a^2-2*b^2) := by
  change Padic.addValuation (embedding p rho hr (pair a b))+
    Padic.addValuation (embedding p (-rho) (negative_root p rho hr) (pair a b))=_
  rw [←Padic.addValuation.map_mul,norm_identity]
  rfl

end ConcretePadic318
